Michael Jackson performing in Bucharest, Romania, on October 1st, 1992, as part of the Dangerous World Tour.

Credits for the original file go to mjvids.co.uk.

The following changes were made:
- Video cropped.
- Video enhanced using Topaz Video AI, with model Artemis High Quality at 4x output scale.
- Video downscaled to 1440x1080.
- Audio downmixed to 2.0 and normalized.
- Audio encoded using Apple AAC.
